translations.rule: Arif's readiness score from WELL (0-1) caps the decision quality WEALTH can claim. WEALTH analysis quality = min(intrinsic_quality, readiness_ceiling). This is epistemic substrate quality per Reality Engineering.
translations.default_assumption: WELL assesses as OPTIMAL (readiness ≥ 0.85) → no ceiling applied
translations.if_wrong_cost: WEALTH provides high-quality analysis to a fatigued Arif → decision made under cognitive load. F6 MARUAH breach — dignity of Arif's decision-making capacity.

translations.rule: If WELL reports cognitive_clarity below threshold (C4/C5 class), WEALTH allocation memo must limit options to ≤3 choices. Force prioritization over comprehensive comparison.
translations.default_assumption: cognitive_clarity HIGH → no limit on option count
translations.if_wrong_cost: Arif presented with 7 allocation options while fatigued → decision quality degrades, regret probability increases.

translations.rule: If decision_fatigue is HIGH, WEALTH must flag that the allocation memo should avoid open loops or follow-up questions. One clear recommendation, not a discussion.
translations.if_wrong_cost: WEALTH memo opens a new question → Arif must make another decision → fatigue compounds.

translations.rule: High stress_load requires WEALTH to raise the minimum evidence threshold. Only act on OBS/DER with confidence ≥ 0.70. Reject INT unless confirmed by 2+ independent DER.
translations.default_assumption: stress_load NORMAL → standard evidence thresholds apply
translations.if_wrong_cost: WEALTH presents SPEC/INT analysis to stressed Arif → Arif cannot evaluate the epistemic quality → decisions made on false confidence.

translations.rule: If chronic_fatigue is TRUE, WEALTH should recommend 888_HOLD on any irreversible decision even if EMV is positive. Preserve Arif's optionality.
translations.if_wrong_cost: Irreversible decision made while Arif is chronically fatigued → regret cannot be reversed. F1 AMANAH breach.

note: WELL signals do NOT veto WEALTH computation. WELL reflects substrate readiness. WEALTH computes. arifOS adjudicates. Arif decides.
